dialogue_texts: Saika
Ugh... I haven't been scorched like this since I was a baby.
Saika
You really are as persistent as the legends say, Empress of the Moon.
Kaguya
Your heat is now a flickering candle compared to the sun. Step aside because I have an Empress' errand to run.
Kaguya
The glohm is beginning to bore me.
Saika
Go ahead... but don't say I didn't warn you.
Saika
The glohm inside is much thicker than the smoke from the flames.
Saika
It doesn't just block the path - it closes the heart.
Kaguya
I've lived through a thousand moonless nights.
Kaguya
A little red mist won't stop me from finding your master.
Saika
You moon-folk are all the same... so arrogant. I hope you enjoy the isolation.
Kaguya
Isolation? I haven't been lonely for most of my life.
Kaguya
Now, let's see if Berenice has any sense of style.
